in_arabic.name: Aanil
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Favor/Grace of Allah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Aanil هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root ‘anā,’ which means ‘to bestow,’ ‘to grant,’ or ‘to favor.’ The name Aanil is a beautiful reminder of Allah's endless grace and favor towards His creation.
